_comment: Measured, not designed. HTTP outcomes of the human-approval surfaces under NAT 1.9 at 87daaa3. 'in_process' drives NAT's real add_execution_routes with the real OwnerAwareExecutionStore and ResponderIdentityMiddleware (recording/interaction_status.py); 'live' rows come from the recorded corpus against the running agent; 'mcp_execute' drives the real Rust MCP server's POST /approvals/execute with tokens from the real Python minter.

interaction_response_route.live_corpus: sse/commit-confirm-radio.json: non-owner, unoffered value and wrong response type each answered 500; the owner's offered choice 204 and the prompt stayed pending until then
interaction_response_route.why_500: InteractionAuthorizationError subclasses Exception; NAT's route maps only KeyError->404 and ValueError->400, so every guard refusal surfaces as an unhandled 500. The refusal is correct; its status code is not a designed contract.
interaction_response_route.gateway_relay: gateway/src/proxy.rs interaction_response relays the agent status and body unchanged; the UI treats any 2xx as accepted

observed.effect: VJPN-LSE moved UNREVIEWED -> RESEARCH; the mutation was applied with no client attached

client_disconnect_while_pending.prompt_timeout: null on every recorded prompt (HumanPrompt.timeout unset): a pending approval never expires while the process lives

cases.case: commit token replayed (state precondition fires first)

body.result: Only unreviewed ETFs can take an initial decision; 'XNIF-XETRA' is REJECTED. Re-deciding a reviewed candidate is a separate action and is not implemented.

cases.case: expected_choice differs from the recomputed engine decision

body.result: Human approval rejected: approval token was issued against a different deterministic decision
Human approval rejected: approval token is not bound to this authenticated request

cases.case: shortlist of a non-UCITS fund with rationale (hard constraint)

body.result: Hard constraint HC-UCITS: The investor profile requires UCITS eligibility and this fund is not UCITS. Change require_ucits in the investor profile to consider it; no human approval can bypass this.

body.error: approval token has already been consumed

cases.body: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: missing field `request_id` ...
invalid or missing internal API key

mcp_execute.agent_handling: approval._execute_blocking: 2xx -> committed = body.ok; any HTTPError (400/401/409/422/5xx) raises ValueError('The approved change was rejected: <body>'), which NAT hands back to the model as a tool error rather than the structured committed=false result.

approval_function_retry: sse/commit-without-request-id: when an approval function raises, NAT re-invokes it (tool_call_max_retries: 2; two FUNCTION_START/END pairs recorded). A raise that happens after the human answered (any MCP HTTP error above) would therefore prompt the human again for the same action. Inferred from the recorded retry; the post-approval case was not recorded.
